items.fact: In 1854 the British made Raipur the headquarters of the new Chhattisgarh commissionery.
The Hatkeshwar Mahadev temple on the Kharun river dates to 1402.
Vivekananda Sarovar, also called Budha Talaab, is described as the city's oldest lake and has a 37 ft statue of Swami Vivekananda.
The Town Hall was built between 1887 and 1889 and was once called the Victoria Jubilee Hall.
Rajkumar College was founded in 1882 and moved to Raipur in 1894.
The Dudhadhari temple is a 17th-century Vaishnav temple known for Ramayana-themed sculptures.
Chhattisgarh became a separate state on 1 November 2000, and Raipur is its capital.
